name: apple-mail-cli
description: Shared JSON-first Apple Mail CLI with full-index search, safe high-volume scheduling, dashboards, and UBD OS handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Guarded Apple Mail search, triage, campaigns, and scheduling.
interface.longDescription: A local JSON-first Apple Mail interface shared by Codex and Hermes: search the full metadata index and conversations, classify bilingual replies and bounces, create visible drafts, rebalance high-volume schedules against account quotas, run resumable visible Send Later sessions, reconcile exact recipient sets without writing to Mail's database, and hand redacted dashboards to UBD OS through its human-review proposal API.
defaultPrompt: Summarize new Apple Mail replies and bounces.
Search my Apple Mail history and show the complete matching conversations.
Audit this outreach manifest against Sent and Send Later.
Rebalance this Apple Mail campaign to finish by my deadline without exceeding daily volume or minimum-gap policy.
Show the campaign dashboard and safely resume the next verified Send Later batch.
Create visible Apple Mail drafts from this campaign manifest.
Attach this redacted Apple Mail campaign audit to the matching UBD OS work item for human review.
Classify this Apple Mail reply and propose the redacted result on the matching UBD OS work item.
Attach a redacted Apple Mail campaign dashboard to the matching UBD OS work item for human review.
